title_zh: 为读书活动加入内容提示和退出选择

scenario.label_zh: 敏感主题读书活动的参加边界
scenario.goal_zh: 明确作品涉及自杀主题并约定提前提示和允许跳过讨论

context_zh: 完全虚构的成人读书活动策划对话：组织者 Nina 与 Sol 安排一本涉及自杀主题的小说讨论，不涉及任何现实个人危机或方法细节。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: The novel deals with suicide. We should say that clearly in the event description, rather than surprise people on the evening.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: Agreed. Participation in that part of the discussion should be optional.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: And no one should be asked to share a personal experience. We’re discussing a book, not inviting public disclosures.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: I’ll add the content note and say that people may step out or skip the discussion without explaining why.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Thank you. Let’s have the facilitator read that wording before we publish it.
